owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.description: Today the operation log is local to each computer, unscoped and unclassified (src/engine/oplog.mjs), its cross-device order is exported and unused, and replication is the whole vault through git. D-SO-REPLICATION-UNIT names per-scope operation-log streams as the target unit and keeps git as the single-writer backup of the whole local vault, with no per-scope git repositories. This contract specifies the stream record, the split of the single log into per-scope streams as a replayable and reversible step that leaves the git backup carrying the whole vault, and the conformance test over two sandbox nodes; the transport between nodes (a git remote per stream, the relay, or daemon to daemon) is undecided, measured before chosen, and not built here. Before building, the streams and bytes a ten-person organisation would produce are counted from existing operation logs and recorded.

criteria.statement: a stream record is the operation envelope of PG-04.1 with the scope and the classification added (no second record format) and carries the causal context and the operation; the single operation log splits into per-scope streams by a replayable and reversible step: the test splits a seeded vault, replays both forms to the same state, reverses the split and compares byte for byte; nothing in Personal changes until the step runs, and the git backup still carries the whole vault after it (src/cli/sync.mjs unchanged in what it commits)

stop_rules: Stop and post BLOCKED when a criterion cannot pass without weakening a test, skipping a test or relaxing an assertion.
Stop and ask when the work would name a client product, a person, a server or a seat in repository text; the client names live in docs/CLIENTS.md only.
Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.
Stop when the work would move convergence logic into the core, vendor the engine, or add a merge engine beside the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs.

Stop when the work would implement a federation, replication, trust, admission or computation feature beyond the specification, schema, validator and conformance test the contract names; the product keeps the planned label on it.
If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.

title: SO-F-12 Replication unit: per-scope operation-log streams carrying classification and causal context, a replayable and reversible split of the single operation log, git kept as the whole-vault backup, and a two-node conformance test that a local-only item never leaves
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-F-12) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design record SO-2.03 (Provenance, retention and invalidation of organisational knowledge) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Memev contracts that land first: SO-F-05, SO-F-03. Pages: docs/DATA-SOVEREIGNTY.md, docs/FEDERATION.md come from the federation architecture documentation (PR #223, branch docs/federation-architecture, not on main); until that merges, the first contract to need a page creates it with its Status section, labelled planned or architectural target, and the later ones extend it. Source in the fold: D-SO-REPLICATION-UNIT (decided 30 October, refined by the OMEGA pass); #222 section 13.6.1; #223 DATA-SOVEREIGNTY.md. Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) Decision verifier D-SO-REPLICATION-UNIT removed: it was lead-decided, not owner-decided. The rule it carried (per-scope operation-log streams, git stays the whole-vault backup, transport undecided and measured first) is kept as criterion text and the two doc greps. (4) Duplicate removed: the stream record is the operation envelope of PG-04.1 (WP04-02, adapters WP04-03) with scope and classification added; no second record format. Transport stays with PG-12.1 WP12-01 and is not built here. (5) Backup cadence made explicit to match the owner decision: the doc grep also requires the statement that the backup runs every few minutes (sync.interval_min, default 5). (6) Verified on main: compareRecords (src/engine/oplog.mjs) is exported and unused, so the cross-device order the fold relies on exists.
